versions.subject: Rule: Windows recon activity
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    CommandLine:
        - 'net group "domain admins" /domain'
        - 'net localgroup administrators'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=1 CommandLine IN ("net group \"domain admins\" /domain", "net localgroup administrators")
